correctness.rationale: The proof reduces the complex order-154 claim to the published square-free lifting theorem with p=11 and N'=14. The packaged exact verifier constructs GF(11^3), verifies an element of order 1330 and primitive 14th roots, covers representatives of both Frobenius orbits, and checks all 16383 nonempty principal determinants for each representative. Every zero count is zero; Frobenius preserves nonvanishing.

value.rationale: The result resolves a natural concrete three-prime square-free case of the published principal-nonsingularity conjecture. It supplies a complete finite certificate for the exact missing premise of a general lifting theorem, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice, and extends the recent order-specific certificate program to a distinct arithmetic configuration 2·7·11.
